decisions.statement: A finding hangs under the domain that finding names.
The domains are nested here the way the domains panel nests them.
A domain with no finding beneath it anywhere is left out.
A domain's count is every finding beneath it rather than every row beneath it.
That count reaches the whole descent rather than the findings hanging directly.
A finding carries no count of its own.
A domain's own findings are drawn after the domains beneath it.
The findings of one domain are ordered by the name each finding is filed under.
A finding naming a domain the nesting never reached is drawn as a root of its own.
Every domain named that way is reported unreached as well as drawn.
A finding missing the domain it is of or the sentence it says is skipped.
Nothing here reads a file the editor holds.

definition: the tree of findings the domains they name are turned into
